title: Sour Cream Mashed Carrots
blurb: Room-temperature butter and sour cream blend into the hot carrots instead of seizing up, so the mash turns out silky rather than grainy.
steps: Take the sour cream and butter out of the fridge ahead of time to come to room temperature.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Meanwhile, halve the carrots crosswise, then halve the bigger half lengthwise, so the pieces are roughly even.
Add the carrots to the boiling water. Cook, uncovered, over high heat, until very tender, about 30 minutes.
Drain the carrots and transfer to a food processor. Add the butter, sour cream, salt and pepper. Process until very smooth, about 1 minute, scraping the sides once.
